name: Lorena Stroud
source:
Lorena has known nothing but humiliation her whole life. The only thing that makes her happy is [url=https://vndb.org/c144575]Nixie[/url]. And she was surprised when I spared her and let her fight with [url=https://vndb.org/c144566]me[/url]. She's afraid I'll humiliate her someday.
